name: feedback-plumbing-root-causes
body:
Root causes for both feedback-plumbing bugs (bug report → spec). No source-spec statement was reconciled; the durable spec is new. [autonomous] Bug A — Feedback→Note reviews silently dropped. Source: `apg review add --project

` writes the Feedback+Reviews halves to the tier mirror, but the edge never lands in `db.lbug` and `apg review list` cannot show it. Inconsistency: `apg.load.spec_rel_pairs` (src/load.rs:867–943) builds `Reviews` over a `to` list that excludes `Note` (shared with `Details`, where `Note`→`Note` must stay illegal); `apg.load.create_schema`'s `CREATE REL TABLE Reviews(...)` (src/load.rs:1156–1158) has no `FROM Feedback TO Note` arm; `apg.load.rel_table_pairs` (src/load.rs:993–1014) derives from `spec_rel_pairs`, so `apg.artifacts.rel_pair_allowed` (src/artifacts.rs:822–832) is false for `(Reviews, Feedback, Note)` and `apg.artifacts.ArtifactDb.merge_edge` (src/artifacts.rs:497–555) silently `return Ok(())` (l.542). Resolution: declare `Note` as a `Reviews` target (keeping it out of `Details`) so the edge is representable and admitted. Bug B — verify gate ignores durable/code feedback. Source: the gate's intended contract (test `apg.plan_cmd.tests.scoped_review_feedback_routes_and_gates_by_scope`, src/plan_cmd.rs:5378) is to check every scope. Inconsistency: `apg.plan_cmd.plan_verify_at` (src/plan_cmd.rs:1584–1721) loads only the plan store via `apg.plan_cmd.load_plan` (src/plan_cmd.rs:32–38) and scopes its unresolved check (src/plan_cmd.rs:1624–1645) to Plan/PlanPhase/Task targets, so feedback in `.trans//.jsonl` is invisible. Resolution: the gate must span `apg.specs.project_transient_files` (src/specs.rs:159–179) — the plan store plus the five tier mirrors; `apg plan complete` stays phase-scoped. `review-surface-unchanged` continues to hold: neither fix changes an `apg review` subcommand.
